text: The tenant shall pay a deposit of €1,200 on signing this lease.
Either party may end the tenancy by giving 28 days notice in writing.
The landlord may enter the premises with 24 hours notice to carry out inspections.
The tenant shall keep the interior of the property clean and report any damage promptly.
A security deposit of two months rent is payable before the tenant moves in.
The rent may be reviewed once every 12 months by written notice.
The tenant shall pay an administration fee of €150 for any change to this agreement.
The tenant gives up all rights to challenge any rent increase under this lease.
The landlord may terminate this tenancy immediately if rent is unpaid for 14 days.
The tenant must give 60 days notice before leaving the property.
